column1: # French irregular lexicon: third-group verbs and the two irregular
# first-group verbs. One row per base; prefixed derivatives (soutenir,
# accueillir, renvoyer, reconnaître) are derived in src/fra.rs by
# longest-base suffix match. Some bases are bound stems that are not
# verbs themselves (crire, uire, clure, cevoir, eindre, oindre, aindre):
# they exist so whole families resolve by prefix.
# Columns (tab-separated); trailing optional columns may be omitted,
#   lemma  pres1s pres2s pres3s pres1p pres2p pres3p  subj_sg subj_pl
#   ps1  fut_stem  pp  [impf_stem  prsp  subj6(comma)  imp3(comma)]
# Derived defaults: imperfect stem and present participle from pres1p
# minus -ons; past-historic series from ps1's ending (-ai → er-series,
# -s → s-series with circumflexed 1p/2p); imperfect subjunctive from
# ps1; imperative from pres2s/pres1p/pres2p (final -s dropped after
# -es, vas → va). The overrides carry être/avoir-class irregularity
# Defective bases (gésir, férir, ouïr, issir, saillir, faillir, traire,
# pleuvoir, falloir, bruire, frire, paître, asseoir) stay out: their
# gaps need variant/defective slots the schema lacks yet.
